heading: Structural formula — one pump cycle
text:
### Structural formula — one pump cycle [RTCT.12.1]

The worst-case execution time of one pump cycle is bounded by:

```
T_run = c_alpha  × R × N_max
      + c_beta   × max_fires × k_max
      + c_agenda × max_fires × log2(max_fires)
      + c_fire   × max_fires × A_max
      + c_ttl    × expired_max × log2(N_max)
      + c_cache  × cap_keys
```

| Term | Big-O | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `c_alpha × R × N_max` | O(R × N_max) | alpha dispatch per newly asserted fact × R alpha nodes matching that schema × N_max worst-case activations |
| `c_beta × max_fires × k_max` | O(max_fires × k_max) | beta join propagation per activation, bounded by the token budget |
| `c_agenda × max_fires × log₂(max_fires)` | O(M log M) | agenda heap insert/pop for M = max_fires activations |
| `c_fire × max_fires × A_max` | O(max_fires × A_max) | firing loop: max_fires activations, each with A_max actions |
| `c_ttl × expired_max × log₂(N_max)` | O(expired × log N) | deadline-heap drain plus the fact-retract cascade |
| `c_cache × cap_keys` | O(cap_keys) | the cache-expiry sweep at pump entry ([NSTG.2.4.2]) |

The cache term is **linear in the cap, not in the number of expiries**: the
sweep looks at every entry to find the expired ones, so a deployment pays for
the cache it permitted rather than the one it used. A large `cap_keys` with a
nearly empty cache still costs a full walk each pump. Sizing the cap is
therefore a WCET decision, not only a memory one.

Every parameter derives statically from the `.dsc` and the deployment-time
`N_max` declaration. The `c_*` coefficients are hardware-dependent and must be
measured per platform ([RTCT.12.4]).
